currency.basis: Logo SVG served by the live official template today (live bytes observed 2026-10-02); site news dated August 2026 confirm active operation. Archive snapshot of 2025-12-22 is byte-identical to live bytes, confirming current use.

identity.basis: Live official site titled «Банк Казани» - официальный сайт; its header logo renders the same bank's mark (green 'БК' monogram + purple lettering). Independent directory banksdaily.com lists the same operating bank under bankkazani.

assessment.independenceRationale: Primary observation is the bank's own live official site (official); banksdaily.com directory provides independent identity corroboration only.

squareStandaloneSuitability.basis: Independent inspection of the original lockup render (render-original-lockup.png) and the working render (render-working-mark.png): the monogram alone is a complete, recognizable standalone symbol; its measured path bounds are square (x 0→38.00091, y 0.02235→38.00091) and it fills the square viewport with no padding, scaling, cropping or added backing. Internal counter (transparent square inside the Б) and all strokes survive.

variant.basis: Two official color variants of identical geometry: violet-on-light (logo-violet.svg, emblem #96d700, lettering #5f0091) and white-on-dark (logo-white.svg). The emblem is one self-contained path occupying roughly x 0-44 of the 244x38 lockup; it is natively square and is the standalone mark of the bank. The full lockup with lettering is not square-cell suitable; the isolated monogram is.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Complete emblem preserved: all strokes, the diagonal К arm and the internal transparent counter of the Б survive in the exact final Desktop renders on both themes; color is the exact original green #96d700 with no invented gradient; alpha preserved; no backing shape added.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Mark is natively square; the square viewBox reproduces original path proportions with no distortion, crop or stretching. In the source/final pairs the isolated mark matches the emblem in the full lockup in shape and relative geometry at identical scale.
candidate.rationale: First icon addition for КБЭР «Банк Казани». The bank's current official header logo (logo-violet.svg on bankofkazan.ru) contains a natively square standalone 'БК' monogram; isolating it byte-verbatim yields a complete square catalog mark. Identity, currency and variant were confirmed in the recorded attempt from the live official site and an independent directory.
candidate.role: standalone monogram emblem ('БК' lettermark) extracted from the official full lockup; it is the bank's mark itself, not accompanying text — the purple 'Банк Казани' wordmark was intentionally excluded as unsuitable for a square cell
transforms: No geometry transformation: the single <path class="cls-3"> 'БК' monogram element is copied byte-verbatim from the bound original material (material.bin sha256 7eeee1751d8c35399aa21d38ed10b5c52abdf76bda4e1d8b896d38164242b91a); no tracing, raster embedding, redraw or new geometry of any kind.
Resolved stylesheet fill to inline fill="#96d700" — the exact value from the original <style> block (class cls-3); no color change.

Omitted the 10 cls-4 wordmark paths, the original <defs>/<style> block and the clipPath wrapper group; the monogram path lies entirely inside the original clip rect (0,0,243.84,38), so no clipped geometry was lost.

Square viewport viewBox="0 0 38.001 38.001" set from measured exact path bounds (x 0→38.00091, y 0.02235→38.00091, svgelements bbox); the mark is natively square and fills the viewport with no padding, scaling, cropping or added backing/circle.

SVGO 4.1.0 trial (config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e, worktree svgo.config.mjs): 809 bytes → 812 bytes (output sha256 d136dcc94be23c64825fd32c7d6b5eb8ff7c71cc4b614b330597736be18585a3) — 3 bytes larger, so the SKIPPED result retained the working version as final.svg (sha256 9f040c087ca24e4c363158b7e1eeb362f25c7b621f8a8ec29abb3e07dbe19eb6). Working vs optimized renders are pixel-identical RGB and RGBA on both themes (evidence/4487/optimized/comparison.png, optimization-notes.md).
candidate.variant: violet-on-light color variant (emblem green #96d700, exactly as in the original stylesheet); the official white-on-dark variant (logo-white.svg) has identical geometry and is the same variant family — the green emblem is the bank's brand color used on both light and dark themes
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the record has no existing icon.svg at the frozen base commit (confirmed pinned-path absence, baseline iconHash null); the candidate replaces absence with the bank's real current monogram, so the visible difference is absent-to-real-icon.

proposals.reason: Original vector source found and verified: the live official site https://www.bankofkazan.ru/ serves logo-violet.svg (viewBox 0 0 244 38) containing the current 'БК' monogram (single path, fill #96d700) plus the 'Банк Казани' wordmark (10 paths, fill #5f0091). An Internet Archive snapshot (2025-12-22T02:51:07Z) of the same asset was retrieved via workflow fetch and its bytes are sha256-identical to the live browser-observed bytes (8076 bytes, sha256 7eeee1751d8c35399aa21d38ed10b5c52abdf76bda4e1d8b896d38164242b91a), so the archive snapshot proves the live asset content. Working SVG isolates the original single monogram path byte-verbatim with the exact stylesheet color #96d700 inlined and a square viewBox 0 0 38.001 38.001 from measured path bounds; no tracing, no new geometry, no backing shape.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Current official header logo of the operating bank, retrieved as an original vector (lossless archive fetch byte-identical to live bytes); its single green 'БК' monogram path (fill #96d700) is a natively square standalone symbol, isolated downstream byte-verbatim with the exact original fill and a square viewBox as the working/final candidate SVG.
